notes: ACCESS: direct fetch, no WAF/blocking (robots.txt is 'User-Agent: * / Allow: /', no Claude-specific disallow). royaldesign.com root is a country-selector page; the actual storefront lives under locale paths (/eu/, /us/, /se/ via royaldesign.se, etc). Used the /eu/ (EU, English, EUR) storefront as the representative catalogue for the royaldesign.com domain per the assignment's brand_site/site_url. LOCALE: site renders natively in English for the .com/eu storefront (confirmed via rendered nav text and product names) - no translation needed, matching the brief's expectation for Nordic design retailers. QTY METHOD: each category page embeds a React SSR state blob (window.__INITIAL_STATE__ -> productsContainer['/eu/<slug>'].totalProducts, an Algolia-backed index paginated at a stable page size of 48). Verified via Rule 1 exhaustion check across all 94 leaf categories: ceil(totalProducts/48) == totalPages in every case (0 mismatches), plus a direct spot-check fetch of the last page of Wall Mirrors (?page=6) which returned exactly the expected 20-item remainder. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the raw Algolia index itself (queried directly via its exposed public search key) is INFLATED - it indexes one record per SKU/variant plus a parent 'variable_X' record (e.g. Candles: site SSR total=149 vs raw Algolia nbHits=292 for the same category), so raw Algolia hit counts were used only to sample product names for content verification, never as the qty source; qty always comes from the site's own deduplicated productsContainer.totalProducts (the number that actually drives the site's own pagination/rendering). SCOPE: RoyalDesign is a large multi-category Nordic-design marketplace (Furniture, Lighting, Tableware, Home Decor, Textiles & Rugs, Kitchen, Storage, Outdoor furniture); Furniture, Textiles & Rugs, Storage, Kitchen (appliances/utensils/cookware/knives), Cutlery (all subtypes), bar tools (ice buckets, shakers, wine openers, wine/champagne coolers, mixed 'Wine & Bar accessories'), Fragrance & Body Care (diffusers/soaps/perfume), Bathroom Decor (toothbrush holders, toilet roll holders, soap dishes/dispensers, laundry baskets, towel racks - functional bathroom hardware, not decorative per Rule 0.4), Kids Room Decor and Kids Kitchen & Tableware (toys/babygym/birthday train dominant per product-title check), Scented Candles, Easter Decorations, Games & Play, Christmas/seasonal tableware, and Place mats & Coasters (mixed textile/functional node) were all excluded after inspection. Candles (WEBCAT_5_1_7) and Wallpapers & Wall Decorations (WEBCAT_5_2_17) were kept IN after sampling actual product names via Algolia (Candles = plain/unscented taper and pillar candles, no scented items found; Wallpapers & Wall Decorations = despite the name, sampled products were wall art/paintings/pinboards/tapestries with zero actual wallpaper rolls found in the listing). RULE 0 GAINS: included Bathroom Lighting (72), outdoor lighting fixtures across 7 leaf nodes (Facade/Bollards/Outdoor Ceiling/Outdoor Floor/Outdoor Table/Outdoor String/Solar Cell lighting), Dressing Table Mirrors (10, a vanity-type mirror), and under Outdoor furniture > Garden: Lanterns & Torch Holders (4) and Outdoor Pots & Planters (154) - both explicitly in-scope product types (decorative lantern, decorative planter) that a room-word filter ('Outdoor') would have wrongly excluded; the fire-pit/BBQ-equipment sibling node in the same Garden branch was correctly excluded as functional, not decorative. RULE 0.6 OVERLAP: 'Outdoor Pots & Planters' (outdoor-furniture/garden, 154) and 'Pots (Decorative Planters)' (home-dcor/decorations/pots, 483) sample largely the same underlying products (e.g. 'Copenhagen Pot Grey/Rose', 'Modena RAW Pot' appear in both) - this is the site's own room-based (indoor Home Decor vs Outdoor furniture) taxonomy split, not a facet re-cut, so both are emitted per Rule 0.6 with this overlap documented here rather than dropped. URL QUIRK: most Home Decor sub-URLs use the literal (misspelled) slug segment 'home-dcor' (missing the 'e') rather than 'home-decor' - this is the site's own real, live routing (confirmed: 'home-decor/...' 404s, 'home-dcor/...' returns 200), not a scraping artifact; canonical links reflect the site's actual working URLs. DUPLICATE/OVERLAP CHECK (S.N. 149 Nordic Nest): w149 scratchpad directory was empty and no c149.json existed in the scratchpad root at the time of this extraction, so no direct cross-reference was possible. Per the brief's framing, RoyalDesign and Nordic Nest are both independent Nordic multi-brand design marketplaces that legitimately carry overlapping third-party brand catalogues (e.g. both are known to carry HAY, Ferm Living, Iittala, Georg Jensen, STOFF Nagel per RoyalDesign's own brand-facet data sampled here) - this is normal multi-retailer brand distribution, not evidence of a single-owner duplicate (unlike the S.N. 142/115 same-domain case), so no duplicate-company determination was made either way; flagging for the orchestrator to cross-check once c149.json exists. EXHAUSTIVE: all 94 target leaf URLs fetched successfully with 0 errors and 0 exhaustion-check mismatches; no nulled qtys in this extraction.
